high_level_description: The image depicts a modern office setting where a person is working at an adjustable standing desk. The individual, whose back is facing the camera, appears to be a woman with shoulder-length blonde hair, dressed in a sleeveless white top and light-colored pants. She is using a computer mouse on the desk, which is equipped with a monitor displaying a black screen with a white circular design. The monitor is part of an Apple iMac, as indicated by the Apple logo visible on the side.
